cohort: The study included 10,642 women who underwent a 75 g OGTT because of risk factors or signs suggestive of GDM.
finding: Applying the WHO 2013 criteria would increase GDM diagnoses by 45%, and women diagnosed with GDM only by the 2013 fasting glucose threshold had higher risks of adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that the WHO 2013 criteria for GDM would lead to an increase in diagnoses and that women diagnosed based on the 2013 fasting glucose threshold alone had an increased risk of planned Cesarean section.
